source_en: Good morning, officer. I just... had a little breakfast. Very liquid breakfast. Very early.
Papers? Of course. Right here. ...Ah. Right pocket. The right pocket.
I am perfectly fine. The cold air — it makes my eyes water like this.
You know what I always say — regulations are like fences. Nobody puts up a fence without a reason. ...What were we talking about?
My friend Otar came through here last week. Big man. Smells like cabbage. Did you see Otar?
I am not drunk. I am just... pre-celebrating. The day has potential.
Do you ever wonder... who checks the people who check the people? I think about this a lot now.
I have stood in queues my whole life. Queues for bread. Queues for papers. Queues for more papers. Today I stand in your queue.
Just stamp it. Whatever stamp you use. Any stamp. I am so tired, officer.
